# weka_organization (Data Source)

Look up an existing organization by UID or name. The API does not return the admin username or password, so those stay null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "weka_organization" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organization UID. Exactly one of id or name is required.
- `name` (String) Organization name. Exactly one of id or name is required.

### Read-Only

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Not returned by the API; always null here.
- `ssd_quota` (Number) SSD quota in bytes.
- `total_quota` (Number) Total quota in bytes.
- `username` (String) Not returned by the API; always null here.
